about: The buffer watchdog's tick and recovery, around its decision (watchdogDecision, tested by test/dead-input-threshold) — the same cases in every edition, run on the engine with a wall clock moved by hand and a stand-in for the recovery's restart. Each case starts a fresh engine at time 0 and runs its 'steps' in order: {"start": true} is a deliberate start (the engine running, then startBufferWatchdog(isRecovery: false)); {"run": seconds, "input": "signal" | "silence" | "none"} moves the wall clock on in 0.5 s steps — after each, a buffer arrives that carries signal, or carries none, or no buffer arrives — and the tick runs at each whole second, as the 1 s timer does; {"restart": "succeeds" | "fails"} is what the restart stand-in does from then on (it succeeds until told otherwise; a success is what the edition's restart does for the watchdog: the engine running again and the watchdog re-armed as a recovery); {"permissionDenied": true} the engine's microphone permission flag raised; {"playFile": true} a file playing; {"stop": true} the engine not running; {"check": {...}} checks those fields now. 'expect' after the last step, and 'check': 'attempts' (the recovery's attempt count), 'recovering' (a recovery in progress), 'givenUp' (the recovery gave up), 'inputDead' (the dead-input warning), 'couldNotRestart' (the recovery gave up after restarts that failed), 'permissionDenied' (the engine's microphone permission flag), 'restarts' (how many times the restart ran), 'restartTimes' (the wall-clock time of each). Expected values are Swift's.

cases.note: the start-up grace: no buffers for 4 s after a start does nothing
no buffers past the grace: a recovery starts, and its restart runs 0.5 s later
still no buffers: the restarts back off 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 4, 4 s; the seventh attempt gives up, but the watchdog keeps watching and warns of the dead input
buffers with no signal for more than 15 s: the dead-input warning and a recovery
a restart observes no signal: a permanently silent input keeps its warning and its attempt count until the recovery gives up (a BlackHole input)
signal returning after the recovery gave up clears the warning, the count and the given-up latch

a restart that fails retries at once, on the next backoff; when the attempts run out the input could not be restarted — said so, and the watchdog, re-armed, goes on watching and warns of the dead input
a file playing: no recovery, however long no buffers come
the engine not running: no recovery
a deliberate start gives the watchdog a clean slate: the attempt count back to 0
buffers carrying signal: nothing to recover
signal returning after the restarts failed clears it all: the could-not-restart and dead-input warnings, the count and the given-up latch
a deliberate start after the restarts failed clears the could-not-restart warning
real audio disproves an earlier "permission denied" determination: a healthy tick clears it
